timing_contract: Issue predictions at120s of each current-free block; only actual samples at or before10/60/120s and completed preceding current pulse are predictors. Targets are nearest native samples to300/600/1200/1800s, tolerance15s.
calibration: Three causal voltage samples per block; no fit to later outcomes. Calibration access is identical for every model.
independent_unit: Complete rest block linked to preceding current pulse; all blocks belong to one half-cell, so block summaries are not independent-cell confidence.
scope_limits: One Li-graphite half-cell and one GITT campaign; no population transfer or diffusion-coefficient identification.
POCV file is preserved but not used because it has a different protocol.
exposure: Only initial pre-GITT voltage rows were inspected at schema stage. Eligible reserved relaxation targets were not inspected. All packaged outcomes become public/exposed.
uncertainty_policy: Report chronological block errors; no independent-cell confidence interval.
outcome_exposure: All packaged outcomes exposed after this campaign.
